title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Path traversal in file upload in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 - File…
description: A path traversal vulnerability exists in the Joomla Visforms extension versions 1.0.0 through 5.6.4 and 6.0.0 through 6.2.1. When the option to retain original file names during file uploads is enabled, the extension does not reduce file names to their base name, potentially allowing attackers to write files outside the intended upload directory.
